title: Project State Report
summary: record the retired Studio Markdown report generator and its replacement owners
content_html:
Project State Report

Retired

studio/services/catalogue/project_state_report.py and its var/studio/reports/project-state.md output were removed by SSP-6.3. There is no compatibility command or replacement generated Markdown file.

Run Uncataloged Files and Missing Source Files from their separate local Docs Viewer report hosts. The shared source-image extension policy that had been imported from the old generator now belongs to studio/services/catalogue/catalogue_media_files.py.
